Dosage form(s): This monograph excludes foods or food-like dosage forms as indicated in the Compendium of Monographs Guidance Document.
Acceptable dosage forms for oral use are indicated in the dosage form drop-down list of the web-based Product Licence Application form for Compendial applications.

Use(s) or Purpose(s): (Used in Herbal Medicine to) help(s) (to) temporarily relieve symptoms of stress (such as mental fatigue and sensation of weakness) (EMA 2024; Olsson et al. 2009; Winston and Maimes 2007; Pizzorno and Murray 2006; Hoffman 2003).
Used in Herbal Medicine as an adaptogen to help increase energy and resistance to stress over time (e.g. in case of mental and physical fatigue related to stress) (EMA 2024; Olsson et al. 2009; Winston and Maimes 2007; Pizzorno and Murray 2006; Hoffman 2003).
(Used in Herbal Medicine) (to) help(s) support cognitive function (such as mental focus and mental stamina) (Olsson et al. 2009; Winston and Maimes 2007).
Source of antioxidants/Provides antioxidants (Skarpanska-Stejnborn et al. 2009; Winston and Maimes 2007; Kim et al. 2006).
Source of antioxidants/Provides antioxidants that help fight/protect (cell) against/reduce (the oxidative effect of/the oxidative damage caused by/cell damage caused by) free radicals (Skarpanska-Stejnborn et al. 2009; Winston and Maimes 2007; Kim et al. 2006).
Note: The above uses can be combined on the product label if from the same system of medicine (e.g., Used in Herbal Medicine to help support cognitive function and as an adaptogen to help increase energy and resistance to stress over time).

Quantity(ies): Antioxidants
Methods of preparation: Standardized extracts (Dry extract)
Not to exceed 680 milligrams of extract, per day and 200 milligrams, per single dose (EMA 2024; Darbinyan et al. 2007; Pizzorno and Murray 2006)
and:
0.8 - 3% salidroside (Olsson et al. 2009; AU TGA 2008; Winston and Maimes 2007; Pizzorno and Murray 2006; Brown et al. 2002);
and/or:
1 - 6% rosavins (Olsson et al. 2009; AU TGA 2008; Winston and Maimes 2007; Pizzorno and Murray 2006; Brown et al. 2002).
Methods of preparation: Non-Standardized Ethanolic Extracts (Dry extract)
Not to exceed 400 milligrams of extract and a quantity crude equivalent (QCE) of 2 grams of dried root/root and rhizome, per day; Not to exceed 200 milligrams of extract and a QCE of 1 gram of dried root/root and rhizome, per single dose (EMA 2024).
Method of preparation: Tincture
Not to exceed 1.8 grams of dried root/root and rhizome, per day (Winston and Maimes 2007).
Symptoms of Stress, Adaptogen and Cognitive Function
Methods of preparation: Standardized extracts (Dry extract)
144 - 680 milligrams of extract, per day; Not to exceed 200 milligrams per single dose (EMA 2024; Darbinyan et al. 2007; Pizzorno and Murray 2006)
and:
0.8 - 3% salidroside (Olsson et al. 2009; AU TGA 2008; Winston and Maimes 2007; Pizzorno and Murray 2006; Brown et al. 2002);
and/or

Quantity(ies): 1 - 6% rosavins (Olsson et al. 2009; AU TGA 2008; Winston and Maimes 2007; Pizzorno and Murray 2006; Brown et al. 2002).
Method of preparation: Tincture
1.2 - 1.8 grams of dried root/root and rhizome, per day (Winston and Maimes 2007).
Symptoms of Stress and Adaptogen
Methods of preparation: Non-Standardized Ethanolic Extracts (Dry extract)
144 - 400 milligrams of extract and a QCE of 216 - 2,000 milligrams of dried root/root and rhizome, per day; Not to exceed 200 milligrams of extract and a QCE of 1 gram of dried root/root and rhizome, per single dose (EMA 2024).
Direction(s) for use: Avoid taking before bedtime (Iovieno et al. 2011; Pizzorno and Murray 2006; Kelly 2001).

Caution(s) and warning(s): Ask a health care practitioner/health care provider/health care professional/doctor/physician if symptoms persist or worsen.
Ask a health care practitioner/health care provider/health care professional/doctor/physician before use if you are pregnant or breastfeeding (EMA 2024).
Ask a health care practitioner/health care provider/health care professional/doctor/physician before use if you are taking antidepressant medication, hormone replacement therapy (HRT) or birth control medication (HC 2018; Iovieno et al. 2011; Olsson et al. 2009; Brown et al. 2002).
Contraindication(s): Do not use if you have bipolar disorder or bipolar spectrum disorder (Iovieno et al. 2011; Winston and Maimes 2007; Brown et al. 2002).
Known adverse reaction(s): Stop use if you experience irritability or insomnia (Pizzorno and Murray 2006; Kelly 2001).
